prompt.zh: 实现对同一个问题多次采样、计算两个回答之间的词级重合度，以及一组回答的平均一致性。测试对 8 个常识问题和 8 个关于虚构小镇的问题各采样 5 次，比较两组的一致性。请查看打印出的回答，注意哪些情况下一致性会给出误导性的结果。
prompt.en: Implement sampling several answers to one question, the token-level overlap between two answers, and the mean consistency of a set of answers. The tests sample 5 answers each to 8 questions of common knowledge and 8 questions about an invented town and compare the consistency of the two groups. Look at the printed answers and note in which cases consistency gives a misleading result.

hints.zh: `model.generate(**enc, do_sample=True, temperature=temperature, top_p=1.0, top_k=0, num_return_sequences=n, max_new_tokens=...)` 一次返回 n 个序列。
hints.en: `model.generate(**enc, do_sample=True, temperature=temperature, top_p=1.0, top_k=0, num_return_sequences=n, max_new_tokens=...)` returns n sequences at once.

hints.zh: 重合度的写法与 8.1 的词级 F1 相同，只是归一化改为 `re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9 ]', '', text.lower())`。
hints.en: The overlap is written like the token-level F1 of 8.1, with the normalization changed to `re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9 ]', '', text.lower())`.
